changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE m_savings_reference_rate ADD CONSTRAINT ck_srr_type CHECK (reference_type='CETES' AND revision>=0);
ALTER TABLE m_savings_reference_fixing ADD CONSTRAINT ck_srf_status CHECK (status IN ('DRAFT','PENDING_APPROVAL','APPROVED','REJECTED'));
ALTER TABLE m_savings_reference_fixing ADD CONSTRAINT ck_srf_values CHECK (version>0 AND revision>=0 AND annual_rate_percent>=0 AND effective_date>=publication_date);

ALTER TABLE m_savings_reference_fixing ADD CONSTRAINT ck_srf_review CHECK ((status='DRAFT' AND revision=0 AND submitter_id IS NULL AND submitted_at IS NULL AND checker_id IS NULL AND decided_at IS NULL) OR (status='PENDING_APPROVAL' AND revision=1 AND submitter_id IS NOT NULL AND submitted_at IS NOT NULL AND checker_id IS NULL AND decided_at IS NULL) OR (status IN ('APPROVED','REJECTED') AND revision=2 AND submitter_id IS NOT NULL AND submitted_at IS NOT NULL AND checker_id IS NOT NULL AND decided_at IS NOT NULL AND checker_id<>maker_id AND checker_id<>submitter_id));
ALTER TABLE m_savings_reference_fixing ADD CONSTRAINT ck_srf_reject CHECK (status<>'REJECTED' OR (reason IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(reason))>0));

ALTER TABLE m_savings_reference_fixing ADD CONSTRAINT ck_srf_effective CHECK ((status IN ('DRAFT','PENDING_APPROVAL') AND open_effective_date IS NOT NULL AND open_effective_date=effective_date AND approved_effective_date IS NULL) OR (status='APPROVED' AND open_effective_date IS NULL AND approved_effective_date IS NOT NULL AND approved_effective_date=effective_date) OR (status='REJECTED' AND open_effective_date IS NULL AND approved_effective_date IS NULL));
